compat.any_console_whatever_plugged.note: Firmware 0.30+, the default for new setups. Finds out what it is plugged into, the way Santroller does, and restarts as the right controller: XInput on Windows and Xbox 360, PS3 guitar on PS3 and PS2, PS3 Rock Band guitar for Rock Band 4 on PS4 / PS5 (or PS4 / PS5 mode with an auth controller on the host port), Switch, Wii Rock Band, original Xbox, keyboard on Xbox One without an auth controller, HID gamepad on macOS / Linux / Android.
compat.group.all.name: All
compat.group.pc.name: PC / Mac / Linux
compat.macos_linux_clone_hero.mode: XInput, HID gamepad or PS3 modes
compat.macos_linux_clone_hero.notes: macOS has no XInput driver: in XInput mode the guitar switches itself to the HID gamepad a few seconds after plugging in (firmware 0.28+).
compat.nintendo_switch_fortnite_festival: Fortnite Festival and every other game
Hold orange while plugging in. Green A, red B, yellow Y, blue X, orange L, tilt R, star minus, strum on the D-pad, whammy on the right stick.
compat.original_xbox_all_original.notes: There are no guitar games on the original Xbox; frets map to A/B/X/Y/Black.
compat.page.anything_else_those_consoles: For anything else on those consoles, PS4 / PS5 and Xbox One / Series modes pass the check through to a licensed controller plugged into a USB host port on the guitar (set up on the Modes page with Advanced on). That is experimental and not yet tested on a console.
compat.page.fortnite_festival_keyboard_m: Fortnite Festival in keyboard mode, since keyboards are never asked to authenticate. On Switch, use Switch mode (orange fret).
compat.page.ps4_ps5_xbox_one_series: PS4, PS5 and Xbox One / Series only accept licensed controllers. Two setups work without extra hardware:
compat.page.rock_band_4_ps4_ps5: Rock Band 4 on PS4 / PS5 in PS3 Rock Band mode (red fret). The game accepts PS3 guitars as legacy instruments.
compat.page.which_mode_use_each_console: Which mode to use for each console and game, and how well it's tested.
compat.pc_windows_clone_hero.game: Clone Hero, YARG, Fortnite Festival, RPCS3 / PCSX2 / Dolphin
compat.pc_windows_clone_hero.mode: XInput (Guitar Hero or Rock Band type), HID, PS3 modes
compat.pc_windows_clone_hero.notes: For Fortnite Festival with XInput, turn on "Star power also presses D-pad left" on the Modes page, or use keyboard mode. Firmware 0.30+ shows up on Windows as one controller of an Xbox 360 wireless receiver, which Steam handles (switch it off on the Modes page, with Advanced on, if a game misbehaves).
compat.playstation_2_guitar_hero.how: Wired into the PS2 controller port (Modes page, Advanced)
compat.playstation_2_guitar_hero.notes: Firmware 0.31+. The guitar answers the PS2 as a Guitar Hero guitar on the controller port, with Santroller's PSX emulation; works on a stock console with retail discs. Not yet tested on a console with YAGCC.
compat.playstation_2_guitar_hero_2.game: Guitar Hero 1 & 2 and other controller-port games
compat.playstation_2_guitar_hero_2.how: USB, game launched from Open PS2 Loader with PADEMU on
compat.playstation_2_guitar_hero_2.notes: PADEMU (DualShock3/4 USB mode) turns the PS3 guitar into a PS2 controller. Only for games started from OPL.
compat.playstation_2_rock_band.game: Rock Band 1 & 2, GH World Tour, GH5, Band Hero
compat.playstation_2_rock_band.mode: PS3 Rock Band or PS3 Guitar Hero
compat.playstation_4_fortnite_festival.n: Assign keyboard mode to a fret on the Modes page.
compat.playstation_4_rock_band.notes: Rock Band 4 accepts PS3 Rock Band guitars as legacy instruments, so no authentication is needed.
compat.playstation_4_rock_band_2.how: DualShock 4 or PS4 auth dongle on the guitar's USB host port
compat.playstation_4_rock_band_2.notes: Shows up as a PS4 Rock Band 4 guitar; the console's security check is passed to the controller. Not yet tested on a console.
compat.playstation_4_rock_band_3.how: Direct USB with the GoldHEN plugin OrbisInstrumentalizer
compat.playstation_4_rock_band_3.notes: The plugin removes the instrument and authentication checks, so no controller is needed on the host port.
compat.playstation_5_ps5_games.how: Besavior P5General dongle on the guitar's USB host port
compat.playstation_5_ps5_games.notes: Firmware 0.30+. The dongle answers the console's security check and signs every input report, as with Santroller. Not yet tested on a console. For Rock Band 4 alone, PS3 Rock Band mode needs nothing extra.
compat.wii_wii_guitar_hero.how: Bluetooth on a genuine Pico W / Pico 2 W (Modes page, Advanced)
compat.wii_wii_guitar_hero.notes: Firmware 0.31+. The guitar is a Wii Remote with a Guitar Hero guitar plugged in (Santroller's emulation): press SYNC on the console, then it reconnects by itself. Stock console, retail discs. Clone "Pico W" boards with an ESP8285 have no Bluetooth.
compat.wii_wii_guitar_hero_2.game: Guitar Hero, Band Hero (with a Wii Remote)
compat.wii_wii_guitar_hero_2.how: Wired to a Wii Remote's extension plug (Modes page, Advanced)
compat.wii_wii_guitar_hero_2.notes: Firmware 0.31+. The guitar acts as the Guitar Hero guitar extension a Wii Remote plugs into, like the original Wii guitars. Not yet tested with YAGCC.
compat.wii_wii_rock_band.game: Rock Band 1, 2, 3, The Beatles: Rock Band
compat.wii_wii_rock_band.notes: Set "Hold at plug-in" for a fret to Wii Rock Band on the Modes page.
compat.xbox_360_guitar_hero.game: Guitar Hero, Rock Band, and every other game
compat.xbox_360_guitar_hero.mode: XInput (Guitar Hero or Rock Band type)
compat.xbox_360_guitar_hero.notes: The console's security check (XSM3) is answered by the firmware, using the same library Santroller ships. Not yet confirmed on a real 360 with YAGCC.
compat.xbox_one_fortnite_festival.notes: Keyboards don't need authentication. Assign keyboard mode to a fret on the Modes page.
compat.xbox_one_rock_band.how: Wired Xbox One / Series controller on the guitar's USB host port
compat.xbox_one_rock_band.notes: Shows up as a Rock Band 4 Stratocaster; the console's security check is passed to the controller. Not yet tested on a console.

meta.description: Free, open-source firmware and browser configurator for DIY Guitar Hero and Rock Band guitar controllers on the Raspberry Pi Pico, Pico W and Pico 2. Map buttons on any pin, calibrate the whammy, set up RGB fret and strum LEDs, and play over USB or Bluetooth in XInput, PS3, Switch, PS4/PS5 and Xbox modes: Clone Hero, YARG, Fortnite Festival, Rock Band.
meta.og_description: Free firmware and browser configurator for DIY Guitar Hero / Rock Band controllers on the Raspberry Pi Pico: any-pin button mapping, whammy, RGB LEDs, Bluetooth, XInput, PS3, Switch, PS4/PS5 and Xbox modes.
meta.og_image_alt: YAGCC logo: a guitar controller neck with coloured frets and configuration sliders
meta.og_title: YAGCC · DIY guitar controller firmware & web configurator
meta.yagcc_diy_guitar_hero_controller: YAGCC · DIY Guitar Hero controller firmware & web configurator for Raspberry Pi Pico
mode.auto_detect_console.desc: Works out what it is plugged into and becomes the right controller: XInput on Windows and Xbox 360, PS3 guitar on PS3 and PS2, the PS3 Rock Band guitar Rock Band 4 takes on PS4 / PS5 (or PS4 mode with an auth controller on the host port), Switch, Wii Rock Band, original Xbox, Xbox One (keyboard for Fortnite Festival without an auth controller), and the HID gamepad on macOS, Linux and Android. Same detection as Santroller. Firmware 0.30+.
mode.hid_gamepad.desc: Generic HID gamepad for macOS, Linux, Android and emulators. Configurable here too (the browser asks for permission once for this mode).
mode.hid_gamepad.name: HID Gamepad
mode.keyboard_fortnite_festival.desc: Shows up as a USB keyboard with Fortnite Festival key bindings, so it works on PS4, PS5, Xbox One / Series and PC without any authentication dongle. Bindings can be changed below.
mode.keyboard_fortnite_festival.name: Keyboard · Fortnite Festival
mode.nintendo_switch.desc: HORIPAD-compatible gamepad: works with every Switch game (Fortnite Festival, rhythm games) without pairing.
mode.original_xbox.desc: Original Xbox controller (XID). Needs a USB-to-Xbox-port adapter cable.
mode.ps3_guitar_hero.desc: PS3 Guitar Hero guitar (12BA:0100). Guitar Hero on PS3 / PS2 (World Tour, GH5, Band Hero) and RPCS3 / PCSX2.
mode.ps3_rock_band.desc: PS3 Rock Band guitar (12BA:0200). Rock Band on PS3, PS2 and RPCS3, and Rock Band 4 on PS4 / PS5 (legacy instruments). Also fine for Clone Hero / YARG.
mode.ps4_ps5_guitar.name: PS4 / PS5 guitar
mode.ps4_ps5_guitar_experimental.desc: Rock Band 4 guitar for PS4 and PS5. The console's security check is passed through to a licensed PS4 controller or auth dongle plugged into the guitar's USB host port. Experimental: not yet tested on a console.
mode.ps5_guitar.name: PS5 guitar
mode.ps5_guitar_experimental.desc: Rock Band 4 guitar for PS5 games. The console's security check and the signing of every input report are done by a Besavior P5General dongle plugged into the guitar's USB host port (as Santroller does). For Rock Band 4 alone, PS3 Rock Band mode works on a PS5 with nothing extra. Experimental: not yet tested on a console.
mode.unknown.name: Unknown
mode.wii_rock_band.desc: Wii Rock Band guitar dongle (1BAD:0004) for Rock Band 1–3 and The Beatles: Rock Band on Wii / Wii U over USB.
mode.xbox_one_series_guitar.desc: Rock Band 4 guitar for Xbox One and Xbox Series. The console's security check is passed through to a licensed Xbox One / Series controller plugged into the guitar's USB host port. Experimental: not yet tested on a console.
mode.xbox_one_series_guitar.name: Xbox One / Series guitar (experimental)
mode.xinput_xbox_360.desc: Xbox 360 guitar: Guitar Hero or Rock Band type. Plug-and-play on Windows (Clone Hero, YARG, Fortnite Festival) and on a real Xbox 360 — the console's security check is answered by the firmware. macOS has no XInput driver: use HID mode on a Mac.
modes.bluetooth_pairing_new_device_pico: Bluetooth pairing for a new device (Pico W / Pico 2 W)
modes.connect_controller_change_its_mode: Connect a controller to change its modes.
modes.console_ports_wii_remote_experimen: Console ports and Wii Remote Experimental
modes.fortnite_festival_pc_reads_star: Fortnite Festival on PC reads star power from there. Leave off for Clone Hero and YARG.
modes.guitar_hero_guitar.desc: Like the Xbox 360 Les Paul and World Tour guitars.
modes.guitar_hero_guitar.name: Guitar Hero guitar
modes.guitar_one_off_setup_session: The guitar is in a one-off setup session (XInput with configuration), which is why it can talk to this page. Unplug it and plug it back in to return to {mode}.
modes.host.ps4_xbox_one_mode_selected: A PS4 / Xbox One mode is selected but the host port is off, so the console will reject the guitar.
modes.host.two_neighbouring_free_pins_th: Two neighbouring free pins. They can't be used for buttons while the port is on.
modes.keyboard_mode_they_have_match: For keyboard mode. They have to match the keys set in Fortnite.
modes.keys.fortnite_festival_lead.desc: Frets on D F J K L, overdrive on Space. Strum moves through menus.
modes.keys.fortnite_festival_lead.name: Fortnite Festival · Lead
Frets 1–5, strum on Right Shift / Right Ctrl, overdrive (star power and tilt) on Page Down, whammy on /.
modes.mac_xinput_tip: macOS has no driver for Xbox 360 controllers. In XInput mode the guitar notices this and switches itself to the HID gamepad a few seconds after plugging in, so Clone Hero and YARG still see it (firmware 0.28 or newer).
modes.mode_pick_this_way_remembered: The mode you pick this way is remembered.
modes.off_by_default_windows_guitar: Off by default: on Windows the guitar is a normal wired Xbox 360 pad. Turn on to present it as one controller of an Xbox 360 wireless receiver instead, which Steam handles better (a wired pad sharing its USB device with the configurator can trip Steam up). If the guitar stops being recognised on Windows with this on, turn it off.
modes.pick_what_guitar_pretends_be: Pick what the guitar pretends to be: Xbox, PlayStation, Switch, PC… Hold a fret while plugging in to switch.
modes.ports.guitar_acts_as_guitar_hero: The guitar acts as a Guitar Hero guitar extension: plug a Wii Remote's extension cable in, like the original Wii guitars. SDA and SCL of the extension plug to the pins below, its 3.3 V detect line to 3V3, GND to GND.
modes.ports.needs_firmware_0_31_or: Needs firmware 0.31 or newer. Update the firmware on the Install page.
modes.ports.pico_w_becomes_wii_remote: The Pico W becomes a Wii Remote with a Guitar Hero guitar plugged in: Guitar Hero, Band Hero and DJ Hero on a stock Wii or Wii U, no Wii Remote needed. Press SYNC on the console; after that it reconnects by itself. Replaces the Bluetooth LE gamepad while on.
modes.ports.ps2_guitar_hero_guitar_guita: A PS2 Guitar Hero guitar for Guitar Hero 1, 2, III and 80s on a stock PS2 (or a PS1). Cut a PS2 extension cable and wire its lines to five free pins; power the board from the cable's 3.6 V (pin 5) through a diode to VSYS. Not with the USB host port (both need PIO1).
modes.ps4_dualshock_4_wired_or: PS4: a DualShock 4 (wired), or a USB PS4 authentication dongle.
modes.ps4_ps5_xbox_one_series: PS4 / PS5 and Xbox One / Series modes need a licensed controller plugged into a USB host port on the guitar. The console's security check is passed through to it, the same way GP2040-CE does it. Not yet tested on a console.
modes.ps5_besavior_p5general_dongle_ps5: PS5: a Besavior P5General dongle (PS5 mode; it also signs every report).
modes.rock_band_guitar.desc: Like the Xbox 360 Rock Band Stratocaster.
modes.rock_band_guitar.name: Rock Band guitar
modes.setup_mode_one_session_nothing: Setup mode for one session, nothing saved
modes.star_power_also_presses_d: Star power also presses D-pad left
modes.use.any_console_or_computer_finds: Any console or computer: finds out which and switches itself
modes.use.fortnite_festival_playstation_: Fortnite Festival on PlayStation, Xbox, PC
modes.use.guitar_hero_ps3_ps2_rpcs3: Guitar Hero on PS3, PS2, RPCS3
modes.use.ps5_games_needs_p5general_dong: PS5 games (needs a P5General dongle on the host port)
modes.use.rock_band_4_ps4_ps5: Rock Band 4 on PS4 / PS5 (needs a controller on the host port)
modes.use.rock_band_4_xbox_one: Rock Band 4 on Xbox One / Series (needs a controller on the host port)
modes.use.rock_band_ps3_rpcs3_rock: Rock Band on PS3, RPCS3, Rock Band 4 on PS4 / PS5
modes.use.rock_band_wii_wii_u: Rock Band on Wii and Wii U
modes.use.windows_xbox_360_clone_hero: Windows, Xbox 360, Clone Hero, YARG (not macOS)
modes.used_when_no_fret_held: Used when no fret is held.
modes.wire_guitar_straight_into_console: Wire the guitar straight into a console's controller port, or let a Pico W be a Wii Remote. These work alongside the USB modes: each one stays quiet until a console talks to it. Ported from Santroller; not yet tested on a console with YAGCC.
modes.xbox_one_series_wired_xbox: Xbox One / Series: a wired Xbox One / Series controller (Microsoft, PowerA), or a Mayflash / MagicBoots Xbox One adapter.
name.error.only_letters_digits_spaces_ba: Only letters, digits, spaces and basic punctuation (plain keyboard characters) work in a device name.
name.name_or_gamer_tag_instead: Your name or gamer tag instead of “{name}”, up to {DEV_NAME_MAX} characters: letters, digits, spaces and basic punctuation. Applies after you unplug and replug the guitar (or restart it), and on Bluetooth after its next restart. Windows can keep showing the old name in some places, and may need the guitar unplugged and plugged in again.
name.only_plain_keyboard_characters_work: Only plain keyboard characters work here (letters, digits, spaces, basic punctuation). Others were removed.
nav.show_expert_options_such_as_title: Show expert options such as tilt sensors, colour order and console ports
save.have_unsaved_changes_guitar: You have unsaved changes on the guitar
save.have_unsaved_changes_guitar_saving: You have unsaved changes on the guitar. Saving restarts it to apply the new modes.
save.saved_mode_changes_apply_when: Saved. Mode changes apply when you unplug and replug the guitar.
setup.bluetooth.bluetooth_with_no_usb_ho: On Bluetooth with no USB host: no button press for this long turns the guitar off; press any button to wake it. Moving the whammy bar or stick counts as a press; tilting does not.
setup.bluetooth.nothing_recorded_switch_: Nothing recorded. Switch on debug logging, then reproduce the problem.
setup.bluetooth.over_bluetooth_guitar_sh: Over Bluetooth the guitar shows up as the same controller as over USB in its current mode (XInput and Xbox modes use the standard gamepad). Hold Star power + a fret for 3 s to switch modes wirelessly. Plugging it into a PC or console switches Bluetooth off until it is unplugged; a charger doesn’t.
setup.bluetooth.pair_hold_star_power_whi: To pair, hold Star power while plugging in or switching on (or hold Star power + Plus for 5 s). The frets double-blink blue until it connects, then the guitar reconnects by itself every time it is switched on. Each mode is its own Bluetooth device (“YAGCC PS3 GH”, “YAGCC XInput”, …), paired once; Star power at power-on forgets only the mode it starts in.
setup.bluetooth.records_bluetooth_connec: Records Bluetooth connections in the guitar's memory, kept across power cycles until cleared, to track down connection problems. Off by default; leave it off for normal use.
setup.bluetooth.this_board_has_no_blueto: This board has no Bluetooth radio. Only the Pico W and Pico 2 W can go wireless.
setup.bluetooth.this_firmware_has_no_blu: This firmware has no Bluetooth log. Update to the latest firmware.
setup.bluetooth.this_pico_compatible_clo: This is a Pico-compatible clone. Its ESP8285 chip only does Wi-Fi, so there is no Bluetooth radio to use.
setup.bluetooth.update_firmware_0_45_or: Update the firmware to 0.45 or newer to make the guitar switch itself off when idle on Bluetooth.
setup.bluetooth.what_was_recorded_while_: What was recorded while debug logging was on.
setup.buttons.prompt.go_next_button_by_i: Go to the next button by itself
setup.buttons.prompt.gp_used_something_e: GP{pin} is used for something else (tilt, LEDs, ports...). Press a different control.

setup.extras.2_2_push_stick_all: 2 of 2. Push the stick all the way round its edge, a few full circles. The ranges below fill in as you go.
setup.extras.buttons_wired_free_pins_lik: Buttons wired to free pins, like the frets. Each one can do something different in every console mode on the Test page.
setup.extras.calibrated_move_stick_check: Calibrated. Move the stick to check the dot.

setup.extras.gp_used_something_else_pres: GP{pin} is used for something else. Press a different control.
setup.extras.several_inputs_moved_at_onc: Several inputs moved at once ({list}). Press only this one.
setup.extras.stick_barely_moved_circle_a: The stick barely moved. Circle all the way round the edge, then press Done.
setup.extras.takes_ten_seconds_until_the: Takes ten seconds. Until then the stick assumes a perfectly centred 3.3 V thumb stick.
setup.extras.two_axis_thumb_stick_two: A two-axis thumb stick on two of the analog pins (GP26 to GP28) that the whammy bar and tilt sensors don't use.
setup.gate.asking_controller_restart_set: Asking the controller to restart in setup mode…
setup.gate.controller_did_not_restart_pr: The controller did not restart. It is probably still running older firmware without this feature: flash the latest yagcc-…uf2 from the Install page, or unplug it and hold Plus while plugging it back in.
setup.gate.could_not_talk_unplug_hold: Could not talk to it ({message}). Unplug it and hold Plus while plugging it back in instead.
setup.gate.found_controller_mode_browser: Found your controller in {v} mode. The browser asks for permission once per mode: press Connect controller and pick YAGCC Guitar ({v2}).
setup.gate.found_controller_mode_that_mo: Found your controller in {v} mode. That mode has no configuration channel, because it has to look exactly like a real PS3 guitar.
setup.gate.found_controller_switch_mode_: Found your controller in Switch mode. That mode has no configuration channel. Unplug it and hold Plus while plugging it back in to configure it.
setup.gate.or_unplug_hold_plus_while: or unplug it and hold Plus while plugging it back in
setup.gate.restarted_setup_mode_if_does: Restarted in setup mode. If it does not connect by itself in a moment, press Connect controller and pick YAGCC Guitar Controller.
setup.ledmap.each_fret_has_two_leds: Each fret has two LEDs, so you press every fret twice in all.
setup.ledmap.frets_strum_bar_are_not: The frets / strum bar are not assigned yet. Go back and map them first.
setup.ledmap.no_leds_are_set_up: No LEDs are set up. Go back and choose fret and / or strum LEDs.
setup.ledmap.press_fret_above_or_strum: Press the fret above it, or strum if it is on the strum bar.
setup.plug_board_running_yagcc_connect: Plug in a board running YAGCC and connect it to start the guided setup.
setup.rgb.addressable_leds_under_frets_o: Addressable LEDs under the frets or on the strum bar.
setup.rgb.apa102_leds_need_firmware_0: APA102 LEDs need firmware 0.32 or newer. Yours is v{major}.{minor}.
setup.rgb.aria_label.question: Question {n} of {length}
setup.rgb.ci_cki_first_led_not: CI / CKI of the first LED. Not the same pin as data.
setup.rgb.gp_each_led_lights_white: {ledType} on GP{rgbPin}{v}. Each LED lights white in turn.
setup.rgb.no_problem_if_wrong_type: No problem. If it is the wrong type, pick the LED type again. Otherwise work through this list.
setup.rgb.not_sure_count_wires_going: Not sure? Count the wires going into the first LED: 3 means WS2812B, 4 means APA102.
setup.rgb.pico_first_led_s_di: Pico {d} → first LED's DI (SDI), Pico {v} → its CI (CKI). LED 5V → VBUS, GND → GND.
setup.rgb.pico_first_led_s_din: Pico {d} → first LED's DIN (the arrow on the strip points away from the Pico). LED 5V → VBUS, GND → GND.
setup.rgb.which_pins_are_they_wired: Which pins are they wired to?
setup.running_console_mode_or_as: Running in a console mode or as a gamepad or keyboard? Find it and YAGCC restarts PS3 and Wii modes into setup for you.
setup.steps.buttons.prompt: Click Set next to a button (or click it on the guitar), then press that button on your guitar. Or map them all in order.
setup.steps.ledmap.prompt: Teach YAGCC which LED sits under which fret or on the strum bar.
setup.steps.review.prompt: Check everything, then save it to the controller.
setup.steps.review.title: All done
setup.steps.rgb.prompt: A few quick questions about your LEDs, then a test.
setup.steps.rgb.title: RGB lighting
setup.steps.tilt.prompt: Use a tilt switch as a star power shortcut?
setup.steps.tiltsens.prompt: Optional: an accelerometer or an analog tilt sensor for star power, whammy or any input. Skip this if you have neither.
setup.steps.whammy.prompt: Move the whammy bar all the way down and back up, twice.
setup.steps.whammy.title: Whammy bar
setup.tilt.gp_already_used_by_another: GP{pin} is already used by another control.
setup.tilt.lifting_neck_triggers_star_po: Lifting the neck triggers star power, like on a real controller.
setup.tilt.several_inputs_moved_at_once: Several inputs moved at once. Tilt only the guitar.
setup.tilt.tilt_guitar_up_twice_within: Tilt the guitar up twice within 5 seconds.
setup.tilt.tilt_not_active_hold_guitar: Tilt: not activeHold the guitar level, then tilt it up to check.
setup.whammy.live_input_move_bar_check: Live input: move the bar to check it
setup.whammy.manual_calibration_leave_ba: Manual calibration: leave the bar at rest and press Capture rest, then hold it all the way down and press Capture full.
setup.whammy.raw_analog_inputs_one_bar: Raw analog inputs. The one your bar is wired to should swing. If the wrong one gets picked, press Use next to the right pin.
setup.whammy.reading_barely_changed_betw: The reading barely changed between rest and full. Check the whammy wiring.
setup.whammy.using_gp_move_bar_through: Using GP{pin}. Move the bar through two full sweeps.
setup.whammy.waiting_bar_move: Waiting for the bar to move…
setup.whammy.waiting_bar_move_2: Waiting for the bar to move
setup.work_through_steps_order_buttons: Work through the steps in order. Buttons and whammy are all most guitars need; the rest is optional.

test.wire_d_pad_select_home: Wire a D-pad, Select, Home or a stick (Setup, More controls) and it shows up here.
test.worked_out_from_inputs_guitar: Worked out from your inputs; the guitar is not in this mode.
test.worked_out_from_inputs_guitar_2: Worked out from your inputs (the guitar is not in this mode)
tune.analog_tilt_sensors_or_i2c: Analog tilt sensors, or an I²C accelerometer (LIS3DH, ADXL345, MPU-6050, found automatically). Each sensor works the whammy or presses star power past an angle you set, alongside the whammy bar, the star power button and a tilt switch. A mercury or ball tilt switch is set up in Setup.
tune.connect_controller_tune: Connect a controller to tune it.
tune.debounce.classic.desc: Any change must be stable for the debounce time (adds latency both ways).
tune.debounce.classic.name: Classic
tune.debounce.delay_press.desc: A press registers only after being held for the debounce time; releases are instant.
tune.debounce.delay_press.name: Delay press
tune.debounce.hold_release.desc: Presses register instantly; a release is held for the debounce time. Lowest latency.
tune.flip_if_bar_reads_backwards: Flip it if the bar reads backwards.
tune.name: Name
tune.optional_fine_tune_how_guitar: Optional: fine-tune how the guitar feels. Most people never need this page.
tune.puts_every_setting_buttons_whammy: Puts every setting (buttons, whammy, tuning, lights and modes) back to factory defaults and saves that straight away.
tune.reset_every_setting_pins_whammy: Reset every setting (pins, whammy, tuning, lights and modes) to factory defaults?
tune.rumble.drives_transistor_s_base_thr: Drives the transistor's base (through about 1 kΩ) or the MOSFET's gate.
tune.rumble.follow_rumble_games_send_gui: Follow the rumble games send. On a guitar, Clone Hero and YARG use the rumble channel for stage kit and star power messages: those are recognised and left out.
tune.rumble.rumble_needs_firmware_0_30: Rumble needs firmware 0.30 or newer. Update the firmware on the Install page.
tune.rumble.short_buzz_when_star_power: A short buzz when star power / overdrive starts, in games that report it (YARG, Clone Hero, RB3 Enhanced over XInput).
tune.rumble.tap_when_note_missed_games: A tap when a note is missed, in games that report it.
tune.small_vibration_motor_coin_or: A small vibration motor (a coin or ERM motor) on a free pin, switched by an NPN transistor or logic-level MOSFET with a flyback diode across the motor; never straight from the pin. It follows the rumble games send (XInput, PS4, PS5, original Xbox) and can buzz when star power starts or a note is missed.
tune.stops_one_press_from_counting: Stops one press from counting twice. Presses still register in about 0.2 ms; the time below is how long an input is locked after it changes.
tune.tilt.adds_whammy_bar_whichever_furt: Adds to the whammy bar: whichever is further wins.
Adds to the whammy bar: whichever is further wins. The whammy dead zone above applies.
tune.tilt.barely_moved_tilt_neck_further: Barely moved. Tilt the neck further and capture again.
tune.tilt.chip_2_not_found_wire: Chip 2: not found. Wire its SDO to 3V3 for address 0x1D (ADXL345), SA0 high for 0x19 (LIS3DH) or AD0 high for 0x69 (MPU-6050).
tune.tilt.done_tilt_neck_try: {note} Done. Tilt the neck to try it.
tune.tilt.hold_guitar_level_way_play: Hold the guitar level, the way you play {v} {v2}
tune.tilt.i2c_module_sda_even_pin: I²C module: SDA on the even pin, SCL on the next one, VCC to 3V3(OUT), GND to GND.
tune.tilt.like_would_star_power: like you would for star power
tune.tilt.looking_accelerometer_check_wi: Looking for the accelerometer… check the wiring (SDA/SCL, power, CS to 3V3).
tune.tilt.low_pass_smooths_reading_media: Low pass smooths the reading, the median drops single spikes, and the gravity gate ignores moments when the guitar is being shaken (a hard strum) instead of tilted. Each is off at 0, as in Santroller.
tune.tilt.no_reading_from_accelerometer_: No reading from the accelerometer yet. Check the wiring.
tune.tilt.no_reading_from_this_channel: No reading from this channel yet.
tune.tilt.no_reading_from_this_sensor: No reading from this sensor yet. Check the wiring{v}
tune.tilt.or_set_everything_by_hand: Or set everything by hand below.
tune.tilt.pick_pins_accelerometer_wired: Pick the pins your accelerometer is wired to.
tune.tilt.rest_tilted_read_almost_same: Rest and tilted read almost the same. Tilt further before setting the other end.
tune.tilt.shapes_how_far_stick_or: Shapes how far the stick or trigger moves.
tune.tilt.source.accel.name: Accelerometer X
tune.tilt.source.accel2.name: Accelerometer 2 X
tune.tilt.source.adc.name: GP26 (analog)
tune.tilt.that_accelerometer_was_found: and that the accelerometer was found.
tune.tilt.tilt_guitar_move_whammy: Tilt the guitar to move the whammy.
tune.tilt.tilt_neck_try_star_power: Tilt the neck to try star power.
tune.tilt.tilt_sensors_need_firmware_0: Tilt sensors need firmware 0.29 or newer. Update the firmware on the Install page.
tune.tilt.two_accelerometers_wire_both_s: Two accelerometers: wire both to the same SDA / SCL / 3V3 / GND; give the second a different address (ADXL345: SDO to 3V3 → 0x1D, the first SDO to GND → 0x53; LIS3DH: SA0/SDO high → 0x19; MPU-6050: AD0 high → 0x69).{v}
tune.tilt.used_when_this_sensor_mapped: Used when this sensor is mapped to a stick or trigger on the Test page. The press threshold is not affected.
tune.tilt.way_will_when_playing: the way you will when playing
tune.tilt_switch.adxl345_lis3dh_mpu_6050: ADXL345, LIS3DH, MPU-6050 on two pins
tune.tilt_switch.all_three_analog_pins_a: All three analog pins are taken by the whammy bar, a stick or the other sensor.
tune.tilt_switch.any_guitar_or_gamepad_i: Any guitar or gamepad input, including stick directions. A stick axis goes to full deflection while tilted.
tune.tilt_switch.do_have_accelerometer_o: Do you have an accelerometer or an analog tilt sensor wired?
tune.tilt_switch.if_indicator_shows_acti: If the indicator shows active while the guitar is level, pick the other one.
tune.tilt_switch.normally_closed_switche: Normally closed switches need firmware 0.33 or newer.
tune.tilt_switch.or_use_setup_find_by: Or use Setup to find it by tilting twice.
tune.tilt_switch.output_one_these_power_: Output to one of these, power to 3V3(OUT), GND to GND.
tune.tilt_switch.presses_input_when_neck: presses an input when the neck is lifted.
tune.tilt_switch.sda_even_pin_scl_next: SDA on the even pin, SCL on the next; VCC to 3V3(OUT), GND to GND, CS to 3V3 (ADXL345).
tune.tilt_switch.sensor_with_analog_outp: A sensor with an analog output
tune.tilt_switch.still_active_with_guita: Still active with the guitar level? This may be a normally open switch.
Still active with the guitar level? This looks like a normally closed switch.
tune.tilt_switch.tilt_not_active_hold_gu: Tilt: not activeHold the guitar level, then tilt it up to check.
tune.tilt_switch.tilt_switch_wired_free_: A tilt switch wired to a free pin {v}
tune.tilt_switch.triggers_star_power_whe: triggers star power when the neck is lifted.
tune.tilt_switch.what_kind_second_tilt_s: What kind is the second tilt sensor?
tune.up_down_share_one_window: Up and down share one window, so a bouncing strum bar can't fire both.
update.configurator_was_updated_reload_p: The configurator was updated. Reload the page to get the newest version.
update.firmware_update_available_guitar_: Firmware update available. Your guitar runs v{major}.{minor}; v{major2}.{minor2} is out with fixes and new features.

tune.tilt_switch.sw520d_hint: SW-520D wiring: one leg to the GPIO, the other to GND, no resistor needed (internal pull-up). Mount it so the ball rolls onto the contacts when the neck is raised. If it reads the wrong way round, use “normally closed” below. The ball rattles, so this type is filtered much more strongly.
tune.tilt_switch.settle_hint: How long the switch has to hold still before the tilt state changes. Auto uses the default of the switch type (SW-520D about 40 ms, mercury the usual debounce).
name.since_this_whole_name: Since 0.51 this is the whole name: nothing is added after it any more (0.46 to 0.50 appended “Guitar Controller” and similar).

backup.section.tiltsw.desc: Mercury or SW-520D, and the settle time of the tilt switch
